# Motius

> > Motius is an R&D company specializing in emerging technologies, AI-driven automation, and digital innovation for industrial and product transformation.

Motius helps enterprises reinvent their business through process optimization, production automation, product innovation, and UX engineering. With offices in Munich, Stuttgart, and Belgrade, the company works with industry leaders like BMW, MTU, and Siemens Healthineers on deep tech solutions.

## Key Topics

- Machine Learning & AI
- Production Automation
- Process Optimization
- Computer Vision
- Design Thinking
- Digital Transformation
- Industry 4.0
- Product Innovation
- IIoT & Digital Twin
- UX Engineering
- Deep Tech
- MVPs & Prototyping
- Autonomous Systems
- Data Analytics
- Software Development

## Core Competencies

- [Process Optimization](https://www.motius.com/competence-fields/process-optimization): AI-driven process optimization using data analytics and Snowflake for business efficiency
- [Production Automation](https://www.motius.com/competence-fields/production-automation): Industry 4.0 solutions with AGVs, IIoT, and AI for automated manufacturing
- [Product and Technology Innovation](https://www.motius.com/competence-fields/product-innovation-consulting): Innovation consulting with design thinking methodology and MVP development
- [User Experience Engineering](https://www.motius.com/competence-fields/ux-engineering): UX design for web, mobile apps, and XR experiences using design thinking

## Case Studies & Projects

- [Customer Projects](https://www.motius.com/projects): Case studies with BMW, MTU, VOITH, and Siemens Healthineers showcasing delivered solutions
- [Automatic Engine Component Detection with MTU](https://www.motius.com/case-studies/automatic-engine-component-detection-with-mtu): Computer vision automation for MTU engine component detection and classification
- [Automated Sheet Metal Design Optimization for Optimate](https://www.motius.com/case-studies/automating-sheet-metal-design-optimization-for-optimate-gmbh): Geometric optimization algorithm for automated sheet metal design
- [Robotic Innovation With the Aumovis LED Wall](https://www.motius.com/case-studies/robotic-innovation-with-the-aumovis-led-wall): Self-driving LED wall hardware and software development for autonomous robotics
